scripts.test: node --test tests/web/*.test.ts && dotnet test Visose.Api.slnx --configuration Release --results-directory artifacts/tests/Visose.Api
scripts.build: pnpm check && node scripts/validate-publication.ts --source && pnpm --dir web build && node scripts/validate-publication.ts --dist
scripts.build:release: pnpm check && node scripts/validate-publication.ts --source && pnpm --dir web exec astro build --config astro.release.config.ts && node scripts/validate-publication.ts --dist --release && dotnet publish api --configuration Release --output artifacts/release/Visose.Api
scripts.verify: pnpm test && dotnet format whitespace Visose.Api.slnx --verify-no-changes --no-restore && pnpm build
